title: fimbristylis complanata var. keniaeensis
intro: Fimbristylis complanata var. keniaeensis, commonly known as East African fringe sedge, is a species of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Fimbristylis complanata var. keniaeensis include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic activities, making it a potential remedy for conditions like asthma and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
